description: This is a front-end source file defining the 'Home' component for a Travel Explorer web application. It imports UI components, theme data, and data fetching functions. The component renders a page layout with a banner, navigation bar, hero/header section, and a destination list. It also fetches destination data asynchronously on component readiness, handling loading state and errors.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component serving as the homepage for the travel application, handling layout and data fetching.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Lifecycle hook executed when the component is ready; fetches destination data asynchronously and manages loading states.
